title: Marcus Jonathan's Letter
wikitext:
'''Marcus Jonathan's Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Alliance|17|A Call to Aid (2)|A Call to Aid}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Dear Captain Silas of Lordaeron

I regret to inform you that I cannot meet the requests that you make, as there is no reliable way to deliver supplies, or get men to the north, nor do I have the authority to make such a decision.

I would advise you and your kin make your retreat to Stormwind, to save your lives from a pointless death. Should you choose to not heed my advice, I can only offer you blessings from the light.

General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind
}}
